svg.title: What a server costs: the same context window under four tool lists
svg.desc: Four horizontal bars on one scale, each the fixed cost of a session before the first prompt. Every bar starts with the same slate segment: system prompt, built-in tools, AGENTS.md and skill names. First bar, the erp agent with built-in tools only: the slate segment and nothing else, the baseline. Second bar, the planner with the whole Atlassian server, tools at-atlassian: a long amber segment, 258 tool definitions, taking most of the bar. Third bar, the planner with thirteen named tools: a short amber segment. Fourth bar, the planner with the server's own discover mode, no tools equals all: a sliver, four tools, discover plus three execute. A note says the lengths are relative and section 5 fills in the numbers from your own context show, and that the cost is paid at tools list, before the first prompt, whether or not a tool is ever called.
svg.text: The fixed cost of a session before the first prompt, under four tool lists. Lengths are relative.
Jira, Confluence, Compass and more, each with a description and a schema
the tools the tracker doc names, and no others
the optional exercise at the end
4: discover, plus three execute tools that run what discover found
THE RULE Paid at tools/list, before you type, every session, called or not. Lesson 2's "count your tools", drawn; section 5 gives you the numbers.
